text:
oliver: noticed invoice preview upward drift for some customers after fallback routing rollout at 02:10. roughly +15% token lines for a small cohort.
tara: saw that. logs show repeated events for the same trace ids where the first event is `final=false` then a `final=true` comes later. preview pipeline counts both.
frank: the preview dedupe key uses `session_id` but the proxy sometimes emits `request_id` only. mismatch causing duplicates to survive dedupe.
sophia: quick mitigation: prefer `final=true` events and drop earlier non-finals by trace_id in preview consumer. low risk change.
ci-bot: deploy status: preview-consumer patch built (ci/preview-consumer#330). tests pass.
oliver: can we also add an `event_phase` tag (`attempt`/`final`) to meter events so downstream reconcilers can be exact?
tara: yes, will add `event_phase`. we'll emit both `request_id` and `session_id` for 2 weeks while we fix producers.
frank: I'll run a 24h backfill that collapses duplicates by `trace_id` and `event_phase=final`. estimate 45m runtime.
sophia: also add an alert: rate of `final=false` followed by `final=true` per trace > 0.5% in 5m window => page.
oliver: ok owners: tara - producer emit both ids; frank - backfill job + run; sophia - alert; oliver - console note for support. ping here when backfill starts.
frank: backfill started at 03:40 UTC. monitoring shows tokens reduced ~17% for affected tenants after collapse.
ci-bot: rollout: preview-consumer canary at 25% now. no errors.
tara: producer patch rolled to canary; both ids present in events.
oliver: thanks team. follow-up: add integration test to CI to ensure `session_id` or `request_id` present on all metering events. closing when backfill completes.
